scope: Historical walk-forward research; no live orders
primary_gate: Each requested calendar month has net marked-to-market portfolio return >= 10%; average-only is separately reported
deadline: entry date + 13 calendar days; force close on the last official session on or before that date
decisions: After prior regular-session close; if flat, enter next session open; no intraday re-entry
capital: Normalized cash account, one position, 100% allocation, fractional analytical units, no borrowed funds; proceeds reusable next trading day
take_profit: Sell limit at 1.05 times actual simulated entry fill; conservative fill at limit, no positive gap windfall; fixed nominal target in split-adjusted units; do not reduce for dividends
training: For each month use only labels with contractual full windows matured before month start; latest 50 eligible dates for policy selection; training windows must end before selection block begins
models: LogisticRegression hit probability + ExtraTrees conditional miss payoff
selection: Choose highest net selection-block portfolio return among policies with >= 3 completed trades; ties prefer fewer trades and higher threshold; if none beats cash choose no action
frozen_fit: Training models are not refit on the selection block after selection
baselines: SOXX positive 20-session return -> SOXL, else SOXS
features: Prior completed daily bars only, 1/5/20 session returns, 10/20 session realized volatility, 20-session drawdown, high-low range, relative volume, sector relative strength, fixed-pair NVDA/AMD participation; no absolute split-adjusted price features
intraday: Available hourly bars used to audit target hit events; requested 5-minute coverage blocked, not substituted or interpolated
news: No complete point-in-time news archive available; not fitted; current retrospective narratives excluded
limitations: Only two years of daily data
Fixed two-stock breadth proxy is not full historical index breadth
TLT is only a rates-risk proxy; no direct Fed futures or real yield series
5-minute and news feature extensions not completed
Already exposed market history is development evidence, not an untouched prospective trial
